<!-- Modified by lavinhoque33, 2026-11-20. -->
## YouTube

- Set backward and forward double-tap seek lengths independently, or leave either side on YouTube’s setting. Playback can now pause instead of lowering the volume when another app briefly requests audio focus.
- Hide **Ask** and its hint in the search field without changing Ask on the watch page. Optionally restore **Play/Queue** when choosing another video during a Cast session.
- Adjust Shorts control opacity or hide the status bar only in the full Shorts player. The video and **Restore screen** control stay visible.
- Fixed a Back-navigation race and duplicate refresh timers in the Minimal miniplayer. This stable release also includes the prerelease fullscreen layout and icon fixes ([#66](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/issues/66), [#70](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/issues/70)).

## YouTube Music

- Hide the **Speed dial** shelf on Home without hiding **Pin** or **Unpin** in song menus.
- Open a newly saved device file from its completion notification. New M4A and Ogg files carry the album track number when it can be verified.
- Fixed a startup crash when forcing Music 6.20.51. Unsupported controls are omitted; the supported version range has not changed.

## Export device files in either app

Copy a published file or playlist to a folder you choose. Playlist exports include an ordered M3U8 with relative paths. Export leaves the source files in place, uses no private stream cache, and does not change your download mode.

**Verification:** 55 focused tests passed. Four supported YouTube versions and six supported Music versions patched without force. Moto testing covered directional seek, interruption pause/resume, Music shelf visibility, Open file, file and playlist export, and forced Music 6.20.51 startup. Cast receiver behavior, full-reel Shorts, hiding Ask on an active rollout, and YouTube’s export UI were not verified live.
